en.headline: Sha Tin public stands free for National Day racing
en.dek: The Jockey Club opens Sha Tin at 11am, with the first race at 1pm and a Grade Three National Day Cup over 1,000 metres; Happy Valley public stands are also free for people aged 18 or above.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club is holding a National Day race meeting at Sha Tin Racecourse today, with public stands at Sha Tin and Happy Valley open free of charge to people aged 18 or above, subject to capacity and the club's conditions.

Gates at Sha Tin open at 11am. The first race is scheduled for 1pm. The feature is the Grade Three National Day Cup, a 1,000-metre handicap with prize money of HK$4.2 million. An opening ceremony is set for 11.50am in the parade ring, where tenors Dai Yuqiang, Mo Hua-lun and Wei Song are due to perform with the Hong Kong Police Band leading the national anthem, alongside a zhongfan acrobatic display.
The club said separately charged areas remain ticketed. The same public-stand waiver applies at Happy Valley. Racing and crowd arrangements follow the club's usual rules for a public holiday meeting.

Sha Tin is served by MTR Racecourse station on racedays and by buses along Tai Po Road. Evening fireworks over Victoria Harbour are scheduled separately at 8pm, with police phasing road closures from 4pm in harbourfront districts.

zh.headline: 國慶賽馬日沙田公眾席免費開放
zh.dek: 馬會今日在沙田舉行國慶賽馬日，上午11時開放，首場下午1時開跑，焦點為總獎金420萬元的三級賽國慶盈；年滿18歲人士可免費進入沙田及跑馬地公眾席。
body: 香港賽馬會今日在沙田馬場舉行國慶賽馬日，沙田及跑馬地馬場公眾席向年滿18歲人士免費開放，名額及場地安排以馬會規定為準。
沙田馬場上午11時開放入場，首場賽事下午1時開跑。焦點為第3場三級賽國慶盈，途程1,000米，總獎金420萬港元。開幕儀式上午11時50分在亮相圈舉行，戴玉強、莫華倫及魏松將獻唱，並與香港警察樂隊領唱國歌，另有中幡雜技表演。
馬會表示，另行收費場所仍須購票。跑馬地公眾席同樣免費。賽事及人流安排按公眾假期賽馬日既有規則處理。
市民可乘港鐵馬場站或大埔公路一帶巴士前往沙田馬場。維港國慶煙花匯演另於晚上8時舉行，警方由下午4時起在海旁分階段實施封路。
